caption:
Curtailment, this year so far. CAISO: curtailed wind and solar output from 1 January to 30 September, MWh was 5,115,404 MWh in 2026, the highest of the 12 complete years held; the previous high was 3,452,749 MWh in 2025.

Checked before it was drafted: 11 complete years before 2026; the floor is 5; 2026 stands 48.2 percent above 2025, the previous high; the floor is 5 percent; every year from 2015 to 2026 is complete.

The claim states a change; it does not say what caused it. the window is 1 January to 2026-09-30 of each year.

Source: caiso_curtailment_daily, as the ERW holds it. ERW table: caiso_curtailment_daily.
